name: aipi
description: Runtime API intelligence for route tracing, contract diagnosis, regression fixtures, CI guards, and cross-repository blast-radius checks.

interface.shortDescription: From failing API to verified code fix
interface.longDescription: Observe local API traffic, map frontend calls to backend routes and schemas, diagnose contract failures, generate native regression tests, guard pull requests, and check cross-repository blast radius through Codex.
defaultPrompt: Trace this API route and compare its frontend and backend contracts.
Diagnose my latest failed local request and generate a Vitest regression fixture.
Check the cross-repository blast radius of this proposed API schema change.
